quotes.quote: The sole access from the sea is through the channel formed by the confluence, at Kurmat Ali, of the Euphrates and the Tigris and known as the Shatt al Arab.

about mid- November, rain causes the first rise and from January to March keeps the river fairly full, although frost in the moun- tains may lower it ; in March, the melting of the snows causes the water to rise and in April and May the river is at its highest ; it falls gradually in July and August, and from then to November the water is at its lowest.

It should be noted that the so called “ flood season ” has little to do with the rains and owes its being almost entirely to the melting of the winter snows in the Caucasus and the highlands of Asia Minor.

Practically the whole of Lower Mesopotamia is beneath the water-level of these two main rivers during the high flood season ; and the rivers are only kept within their banks by means of slight dams of loote earth heaped up at the edge"of the rivers.
